questions.question: You need to copy the image python:3.12-slim from Docker Hub into your Azure container registry named contosoacr. The computer that you use does not have Docker installed. Which command should you run?

options.text: az acr import --name contosoacr --source docker.io/library/python:3.12-slim --image python:3.12-slim
options.why: Correct. az acr import copies the image on the server side without a local Docker engine.

options.text: docker pull python:3.12-slim followed by docker push
options.why: These commands require Docker on the local computer.

options.text: az acr repository show-tags --name contosoacr --repository python
options.why: This lists tags that already exist in the registry. It does not copy images.

options.text: az acr login --name contosoacr
options.why: This signs in to the registry. It does not copy images.

questions.explanation: az acr import copies images from another registry directly into Azure Container Registry.

questions.question: A production deployment references the image contosoacr.azurecr.io/ragapi:latest. After a node restart, some pods run different code from others. What should you do to ensure that every replica runs exactly the same image?

options.text: Deploy by using a unique tag, such as a version number, or by using the image digest
options.why: Correct. A digest always identifies the same image, and a unique tag that is never reused avoids the drift.

options.text: Enable the admin account on the registry
options.why: The admin account affects authentication, not which image a tag points to.

options.text: Upgrade the registry to the Premium SKU
options.why: The SKU does not change how tags are resolved.

options.text: Push the image again with the latest tag
options.why: Pushing latest again moves the tag and can make the problem worse.

questions.explanation: Tags such as latest can be moved. Unique tags or digests identify a fixed image.

questions.question: You must prevent the image ragapi:2.0.0 in the registry contosoacr from being overwritten or deleted. Which command should you run?

options.text: az acr repository update --name contosoacr --image ragapi:2.0.0 --write-enabled false --delete-enabled false
options.why: Correct. Setting write-enabled and delete-enabled to false locks the image.

options.text: az acr repository delete --name contosoacr --image ragapi:2.0.0
options.why: This deletes the image.

options.text: az acr update --name contosoacr --admin-enabled false
options.why: This disables the admin account. It does not lock an image.

options.text: az acr repository show-tags --name contosoacr --repository ragapi
options.why: This lists the tags and does not change any attributes.

questions.explanation: Image locking is configured by setting the write-enabled and delete-enabled attributes to false.

questions.question: Your company runs AKS clusters in three Azure regions. Each cluster must pull images from a registry endpoint in its own region, and the images must be managed as a single registry. Which registry configuration should you use?

options.text: A Premium SKU registry with geo-replication to the three regions
options.why: Correct. Geo-replication is available in the Premium SKU and serves images from a regional replica of one registry.

options.text: A Standard SKU registry with a webhook
options.why: Webhooks send notifications. They do not replicate images.

options.text: Three Basic SKU registries managed separately
options.why: Separate registries do not meet the single-registry requirement.

options.text: A Basic SKU registry with the admin account enabled
options.why: The admin account does not provide regional replication.

questions.explanation: Geo-replication, which requires Premium, gives each region a local replica of a single registry.

questions.question: A developer needs to list all tags in the ragapi repository of the registry contosoacr, with the most recent first. Which command should the developer run?

options.text: az acr repository show-tags --name contosoacr --repository ragapi --orderby time_desc
options.why: Correct. show-tags lists the tags in a repository, and time_desc orders them newest first.

options.text: az acr repository list --name contosoacr
options.why: This lists repositories, not the tags within a repository.

options.text: az acr task list --registry contosoacr
options.why: This lists ACR tasks, not image tags.

options.text: az acr build --registry contosoacr --image ragapi .
options.why: This builds and pushes a new image.

questions.explanation: az acr repository show-tags returns the tags for a repository.
